items.description: Report does not give the numeric fee values or the oracle fee formula, so correct_fee_expected is a symbolic reference quantity grounded only by the intent that the computed fee should match the fee sent.
Report does not fully specify whether the fee mismatch is the sole revert cause versus other oracle errors, so the fee-equality relation is the selected observable rather than the revert itself.
Report does not fully specify whether fee mismatch is the sole revert cause versus other oracle errors, so the revert observable is bound to the fee-mismatch revert only.
Report does not give a numeric or structural definition of 'prices become stale'; staleness is represented only by the absence of a completed inverse-direction price update.
